request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One clear real-world documentary photograph for a Spanish-speaking beginner's English review. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material grain and plausible lighting, realistic anatomy and hands. NOT an illustration, collage, cutout, split panel or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, internal padding, fake blur bands, watermarks, captions, speech bubbles, logos or readable words except an explicitly requested numeral. A first-time learner must recognize the meaning at phone size: the key person, action and object are large, sharp and inside the central safe area. Fresh scenes for this review only; never imitate a previous course photo. Ordinary anonymous people, never the recurring course cast (no Ana, Luis, Sofia or Diego).

A close overhead-angled photograph of bread alone on a wooden board in daylight: one whole crusty loaf with two thick slices cut from it lying beside it, the open crumb clearly visible. The bread fills at least 55% of the frame width and is sharp from crust to crumb. Nothing else edible is in the frame: no rice, no eggs, no fruit, no plate of other food, no people, no hands, no readable words, no brand marks.

cost.basis: Reported usage at uncached list rates; before tax or discounts, not an invoice.

agent_review.notes: Inspected: one crusty round loaf with two thick slices cut from it on a wooden board, open crumb clearly visible, filling most of the frame; no rice, eggs, fruit or other food and no people or text.

change_control.reason: Lesson 5.2 teaches bread and the old review could only show it by repeating a teaching card.

Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, internal padding, fake blur bands, watermarks, captions, speech bubbles, logos or readable words except an explicitly requested numeral. A first-time learner must recognize the meaning at phone size: the key person, action and object are large, sharp and inside the central safe area. Fresh scenes for this review only; never imitate a previous course photo. Ordinary anonymous people, never the recurring course cast (no Ana, Luis, Sofia or Diego).

Use case: text-exact. A café price tag standing in front of one tall glass of orange juice on a counter, photographed straight on and close in daylight. The tag is a plain white card in a small metal holder and shows exactly the characters $4 in clean black handwriting, nothing else: no decimals, no cents, no words, no other numerals anywhere in the frame. The tag fills at least 30% of the frame width, is perfectly sharp and fully legible, and the glass of juice behind it is recognisable but secondary. No second price tag, no people, no hands, no logos.

cost.basis: Reported usage at uncached list rates; before tax or discounts, not an invoice.

agent_review.notes: Inspected: a white café price card in a metal holder reads exactly $4 in clean black handwriting beside a tall glass of orange juice; no decimals, words or other numerals appear anywhere and there are no people or hands.
